groups.n: Kennels, car parking and the Auckland night.

groups.t: North Island to Picton, both ways
groups.n: Northern Explorer to Wellington, then the Interislander across to Picton.
Picton to Christchurch by the Coastal Pacific or by road (pick one), then drive ourselves to Fiordland. The way back mirrors the way down.

cards.t: Auckland night on the way out
cards.op: The Hotel Britomart · night before the Northern Explorer
sp: Our choice for the Auckland nights, in Britomart, a short walk from Strand station
Drop the dogs at Brookby in daylight, then a relaxed evening in the city
sw: The City View Room Twin has two beds, so one room works with our twin-beds rule

cards.t: Poppy and Rua at Brookby Lodge
cards.op: Manurewa · 2 small dogs · cost scales with trip length
sp: Kennels you already know, which have had Poppy and Rua before
Food and bedding supplied
sw: Open 7 days, 7:00 or 7:30am to 6pm, so late-afternoon drop-off and pick-up are fine
Up-to-date vaccination booklets needed, including kennel cough
Public holidays add $16 per dog per day; peak surcharge 20 Dec to 15 Jan and at Easter

cards.op: 12 nights, Wed 29 Sep to Mon 11 Oct · the car comes in from Brookby and goes back out
sp: One less thing to think about: the car is parked once and collected on the last morning
sw: AT Railway Station car park, Beach Road (entry off Te Taou Crescent): beside the Strand station, open 24 hours, 7 days
AT car park rates: weekdays NZD 12 by day and NZD 17 overnight, weekends NZD 17 per 24 hours

Park and ride: free, on the way in from Brookby. Panmure station has park and ride; Eastern Line train to Britomart station, beside the hotel. AT says park and rides can currently be used for free, for unlimited time, for any reason
Park and ride: AT plans to start charging people who park and don't ride; confirm overnight stays are still allowed in 2027. Albany is the exception now: paid, pre-booked, at most 5 days per booking

Free: unrestricted street parking further out near an Eastern Line station (Glen Innes or Meadowbank, say), on the way in from Brookby. Then the train to Britomart station, beside the hotel, or a taxi of about 10 km
Free street parking: no AT time limit for a registered car, but it is unattended on a street for 12 nights; check the signs
AT car park: no maximum stay published; confirm 12 nights is allowed
Britomart Car Park, 88 Quay Street, near the hotel: 24/7, long-stay pre-booking at mycarpark.co.nz (rate not published)
Hotel valet: NZD 70 a day, and may not keep the car while we're not guests
Ngaoho Place car park beside the platform is now run by Kiwi Parking: rates not found
cards.b: Estimates for 12 nights. AT car park: about NZD 300 from its flat rates. Park and ride: free parking plus train fares, about NZD 20. Free street parking plus a taxi each way at about NZD 4 flagfall and NZD 3 a km (gobytaxi): about NZD 80; by train, a few dollars. Britomart Car Park: placeholder, long-stay rate not published. Hotel valet: NZD 70 a day (hotels.com).

AT parking strategy: park and ride info sheet
AT: Albany pre-booked park and ride terms

cards.op: Great Journeys · Auckland Strand ⇄ Wellington · about 10.5–11 h each way
sp: A full cross-section of the North Island in one day: farmland, the King Country, the volcanic plateau and the Kāpiti Coast
The Raurimu Spiral, a 1908 loop-and-tunnel climb, and the high viaducts over the plateau
Ruapehu, Tongariro and Ngauruhoe close by on a clear day
Open-air viewing carriage
sw: Scenic Plus brings a chef-cooked meal and wine to your seat: the closest thing to VIP rail in NZ
A few tables of four. Ask for one for games (not guaranteed)
Southbound Mon, Thu, Sat (07:45); northbound Wed, Fri, Sun (07:55)
cards.b: Both ways. About NZD 250 / 500 per person each way (seat61, may be dated).

cards.op: Wellington ⇄ Picton · about 3.5 h each way
sp: The approach through Tory Channel into Queen Charlotte Sound, the best scenery of the crossing
Kaitaki Plus lounge: quieter, with food and drinks included
Bags check through to Christchurch, so nothing to handle at Picton
sw: Southbound, the 08:45 sailing meets the 13:40 Coastal Pacific; northbound, the 07:00 train meets the 14:15 sailing
cards.b: Both ways. Fare from about NZD 60–80 per person each way, Plus lounge about NZD 80 per person extra (seat61).

links.l: Seat61: New Zealand trains and ferry

cards.op: Great Journeys · Picton ⇄ Christchurch · about 5 h 20 each way
sp: Through Marlborough wine country, then right along the Kaikōura coast where the mountains meet the sea
Seals on the rocks and the chance of seeing whales offshore
Open-air viewing carriage
sw: Southbound leaves Picton 13:40, arrives 19:30; northbound leaves Christchurch 07:00, arrives 12:40
Runs Thu–Sun in spring and not at all May–August: use the Picton drive instead
cards.b: Both ways. From NZD 219 per person each way (Great Journeys); Scenic Plus about NZD 499 per person each way (seat61).

links.l: Seat61: New Zealand trains and ferry

cards.op: Rental collected and returned at Picton, kept for the whole South Island · about 4.5–5 h each way
sp: The coast road past Kaikōura: seals on the rocks and mountains dropping to the sea
Marlborough vineyards around Blenheim
Works in any season, including when the Coastal Pacific is not running
sw: Use this when the southern rail is not available
One of us drives instead of watching from the train
On the way home, a night in Picton before the morning ferry
cards.b: Rough estimate: extra rental days for collecting at Picton instead of Christchurch, plus fuel.

cards.op: Rental car, collected and returned at a Christchurch city branch · kept through the cruise
sp: Down: two nights at The Hermitage under Aoraki/Mt Cook, then Te Anau the night before the cruise. Back: a night in Wanaka
The car stays with us: park at Manapouri for the RealNZ cruise (about 950 m from the visitor centre)
Central Otago orchards and wineries along the way
sw: We set our own pace and stops
Direct means one long day of about 7–8 hours each way
cards.b: Rough estimate for the rental for the South Island loop plus fuel. Hermitage down, Wanaka back: two nights at Aoraki/Mt Cook going down, Wanaka coming back. Two breaks: Tekapo and Wanaka each way.

cards.op: Chosen · Tuesday sailing · 3 days, 2 nights from Manapouri · up to 36 guests · shared bathrooms
sp: Doubtful Sound: far bigger and much quieter than Milford, with no day-trip crowds overnight
Lake Manapouri crossing and the Wilmot Pass road in, with no aircraft at all
A full middle day exploring remote arms, kayaking or the tender, with a nature guide
Bottlenose dolphins, fur seals and Fiordland crested penguins are all possible. Spring is penguin nesting season (verify)
sw: No aircraft: road and lake crossing
Sails Tue, Thu and Sat in October 2027, so the trains line up with a Tuesday start
Tue 19 Oct is not available. Sailing 26 Oct puts the trip south over Labour Weekend (23–25 Oct)
October is inside the sandfly peak: accepted by Andrew, check with Millie
Two-person cabins with shared bathrooms, no ensuites (RealNZ). Bed layout not stated, so it could be bunks: ask RealNZ
cards.b: From NZD 789 per person on the RealNZ booking calendar for October 2027 sailings (checked 28 Oct 2026), for two. Cabin type behind that fare not confirmed.

links.l: RealNZ: Doubtful Sound overnight cruises (cabin details)

cards.op: From Manapouri · up to 52 guests · 26 private ensuite cabins, twin or double · May and Aug
sp: Same route as the Wanderer on a larger boat
Private twin cabins with ensuites
Winter: snow on the tops, fewer sandflies (never none), few other visitors
sw: Sails in May and August, when sandflies are fewer
The Coastal Pacific does not run then
cards.b: About NZD 1,099 per person twin share (May–Aug 2027), plus an optional NZD 41 picnic lunch each.

links.l: RealNZ: Doubtful Sound overnight cruises (cabin details)

cards.op: Fiordland Discovery · 1 night · about 20 guests · late Oct–Apr
sp: Milford Sound after the day boats have gone: sunset and sunrise under Mitre Peak
Top-deck hot tub after dinner, with stars if it clears
Three-course dinner with Mt Difficulty wines
Kayaks, tender trips and a seabed camera (ROV)
sw: The most luxurious feel, and the Endeavour cabin has twin king singles
No aircraft needed: drive the Milford Road
Runs late October to April: the sandfly peak
cards.b: From NZD 2,380 per person twin share (Oct–Dec 2026 and Apr 2027 rate). Van transfer extra.

cards.op: 9–13 Aug 2027 · 4 nights · 18 guests · Te Anau → Dusky Sound → Doubtful Sound → Te Anau
sp: Expert naturalist guides on a true expedition yacht, 18 guests at most
Dusky Sound: Cook's 1773 Astronomer's Point and Anchor Island, then north through Breaksea Sound and Acheron Passage to Doubtful Sound
August: the lowest sandfly period, snow on the tops
House drinks, landing fees and transfers included; ensuite cabins
sw: Salvin's Twin cabin: two lower berths, fits our twin-beds rule
Helicopter in from Te Anau: allowed only because there is no other way in
Transfer details conflict on the page (helicopter in and coach out, or the reverse): confirm with Heritage
cards.b: Salvin's Twin USD 2,936 per person with the 20% offer (USD 3,670 without), for two, converted at 1 USD = 1.70 NZD. Offer: new bookings before 30 October 2026, July–September 2027 Fiordland departures; excludes landing fees and optional extras.

cards.op: Southern Fiords Discovery · 18 guests · 19 Sep and 25 Sep 2027
sp: The far south: Preservation and Chalky Inlets, gold-rush and whaling history, Puysegur Point lighthouse
Dusky, Breaksea and Doubtful Sounds in one voyage
Naturalist guides, house drinks
sw: The 19 Sep sailing falls outside the October–April sandfly peak
Depends on the Coastal Pacific running by mid-September
Helicopter leg: allowed only because there is no other way in
cards.b: Salvin's Twin USD 5,110 per person, converted at 1.70. About NZD 13,900 with the 20% offer.
